source: Schola Europaea – Discovery of the World Syllabus, Primary cycle (P1-P5), réf. 2015-09-D-30-en-3, approuvé en février 2016, en vigueur depuis le 01/09/2016 – objectifs de Year 3 (P3).
note: Objectifs repris du syllabus (en anglais), regroupés en 4 thèmes comme en P4 ; chaque objectif est précédé du nom de son chapitre. « defis » = objectifs de P4 liés au thème. Pas de « revisions » : les objectifs de P1-P2 n'ont pas été extraits. Ont été écartés les objectifs impossibles à évaluer par un quiz (observer, enquêter, jouer avec des aimants). L'objectif « Describe and discuss why a society has to follow rules (Safe Cross Code…) » n'est pas repris dans le thème Histoire (choix de relecture).

objectifs: La reproduction des plantes – Describe and record the different stages of the reproduction of plants (e.g. from flower to fruit, from cones to trees)
La reproduction des plantes – Be aware of the importance of insects in the reproduction process of plants
Ma ville – Describe the main characteristics of a town including the services it provides (e.g. hospitals, banks, schools)
Ma ville – List the various means of public transport
Ma ville – Discuss simple journeys to and from different places using different forms of transport
Ma ville – Describe and compare the landscape of a town with that of the countryside
Le cycle de l'eau – Describe the water cycle in detail (evaporation, condensation, precipitation, run-off)
Le cycle de l'eau – Revise the different states of water (solid, liquid, gas) and their role in the cycle
defis: Les écosystèmes – Become familiar with and describe a food chain as a feeding relationship in an ecosystem
Climat et météo – Describe the relationship between weather and climate

objectifs: L'oreille et le son – Describe the function of the ear and know the names of the main parts
L'oreille et le son – Become familiar with how sound is produced
L'oreille et le son – Develop an awareness of the health aspects concerning sound (e.g. noise pollution, loud music)
L'oreille et le son – Explore how sound travels through materials
L'oreille et le son – Discover how people deprived of hearing communicate with others (e.g. sign language)
Le squelette et les muscles – Describe the skeleton and know names of the major bones
Le squelette et les muscles – Recognise, name and describe the main types of joints
Le squelette et les muscles – Become familiar with the main muscle groups
Le squelette et les muscles – Describe how the skeleton and muscles function in relation to one another
Le squelette et les muscles – Explore and investigate how people move (roles of bones, muscles and joints)
defis: L'œil et la vue – Describe the function of the eye and know the names of the main parts

objectifs: Le magnétisme – Describe the properties of magnets
Le magnétisme – Recognise some areas where magnets are used (e.g. compasses, fridge magnets)
Le magnétisme – Learn that magnets can attract or repel magnetic materials
Le magnétisme – Explore the use of magnets to lift and hold objects
Le recyclage – Become aware that recycled materials (e.g. paper, glass, plastic) are used to produce new products
Le recyclage – Sort various materials for recycling
Le recyclage – Describe the process of recycling and explain the benefits of recycling to the community
defis: L'électricité – Carry out simple experiments with electricity (e.g. conductors and insulators)

objectifs: La Préhistoire – Become familiar with and describe some aspects of the lives of people in prehistoric times
La Préhistoire – Discuss a range of simple evidence (e.g. pictures of tools, cave art)
La Préhistoire – Record the different ages on appropriate timelines
La Préhistoire – List the main characteristics of each period (e.g. Stone Age, Bronze Age, Iron Age)
Patrimoine et société – Describe and discuss the need to preserve heritage (e.g. local and national traditions, monuments)
defis: Le Moyen Âge – Become familiar with and describe aspects of people's lives in the Middle Ages (e.g. homes, clothes, farming, food)
